name: I-29 Speedway Long Course Chicane
description: Long course of I-29 Speedway with two track-day cone chicanes on the west double-straight: right-then-left on the southbound main straight, left-then-right on the northbound return. Driving through a chicane is off-track (soft SCUT); the cone line stays valid. The short-course T1 hairpin stays closed. 36 paddock pit boxes. Length is the fast_lane closed loop (3.567 km).
author: Vybes Forge
